record: D765 (the China open on MHG and SIL): the holiday control, built before the pre-registration's runner
contents: weekday dates on which the Shanghai exchanges (SSE; SHFE keeps the same national-holiday closures) did not trade; no price

source.how: the precomputed_shanghai_holidays list of exchange_calendars' XSHG calendar, read as source text via the GitHub API (contents endpoint, commit 20ed4736, 2026-01-07); nothing installed
source.assumption: SHFE's day session closes on the same national-holiday weekdays as the SSE; both follow the State Council's annual holiday notice

verification.2020: the Spring Festival closure extended to 2020-01-31 (State Council, 27 Jan 2020); SHFE, INE and ZCE reopened 2020-02-03 (Yicai Global, 'Commodity Exchanges in China Postpone Trading for One More Day'; ISDA guidance of 3 Feb 2020). The list has 01-24, 01-27..01-31.
verification.2023: State Council 2023 notice: Dragon Boat 22-24 June; Mid-Autumn and National Day 29 Sep - 6 Oct (china-briefing.com, 'China Public Holiday 2023 Schedule'). The list has 06-22, 06-23, 09-29, 10-02..10-06.
verification.2018: State Council notice of 30 Nov 2017: Spring Festival 15-21 Feb, Labour Day 29 Apr - 1 May, National Day 1-7 Oct; New Year 30 Dec 2018 - 1 Jan 2019 (china-briefing.com, 'China's 2018 Holiday Schedule'). The list has 02-15, 02-16, 02-19..02-21, 04-30, 05-01, 10-01..10-05, 12-31.

not_covered: SHFE night-session suspensions before holidays (not needed: the control is the 09:00 Beijing day open); weekend make-up workdays (exchanges do not trade on weekends)
